standard_prerequisites.name: The representation of the internal hom along a finite map by a bounded complex of injectives
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 3032-3036)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives finite injective dimension of the resulting complex.

standard_prerequisites.name: The preservation of bounded below coherent complexes by the internal hom along a finite map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3038-3039)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that the resulting complex has finite cohomology modules.

standard_prerequisites.name: The adjunction between the internal hom along a finite map and restriction, together with the dualizing property of the original complex
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3040-3052)
standard_prerequisites.use: Computes the hom modules of the resulting complex with itself, which are the last property of a dualizing complex.

core_obligations: Injective dimension: represent the original complex by a bounded complex of injectives, so that applying hom out of the finite module over the source gives a bounded complex of injective modules over the target (proof lines 3031-3037)
Coherence: the internal hom along a finite map preserves bounded below coherent complexes, so the result has finite cohomology modules (proof lines 3038-3039)

Duality: the hom module of the result with itself is computed over the source by adjunction and equals the source in degree zero with all shifted hom modules vanishing, which is the remaining property of a dualizing complex (proof lines 3040-3052)
proof_roadmap: 取 ω_A^• → I^• 为有界内射复形的拟同构；则 Hom_A(B, I^•) 是 B 上的有界内射复形（hom-injective）⇒ 内射维数有限。
由 exact-support-coherent 该复形属于 D_Coh(B)。
由 right-adjoint 与 dualizing 计算同态：Hom_{D(B)}(RHom(B,ω), RHom(B,ω)) = Hom_{D(A)}(RHom(B,ω), ω) = B，非零移位为零 ⇒ 满足对偶复形的最后一条。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that for a finite ring map of Noetherian rings the internal hom out of the target, applied to a dualizing complex over the source, is a dualizing complex over the target (author lemma at source lines 3024-3029, label lemma-dualizing-finite). The proof (source lines 3031-3053) obtains finite injective dimension from a bounded complex of injectives representing the original complex, coherence from the preservation statement for finite maps, and checks the last defining property by computing the hom modules of the result with itself over the source by adjunction, where they are the source in degree zero and vanish otherwise (proof lines 3040-3052). The hom computation is the substance. H3.
